SELECT ivtr.inventory_id, proc.product_code, proc.name AS product_name, wrhs.warehouse_code, wrhs.name AS warehouse_name, ivtr.on_hand_qty, ivtr.reseved_qty FROM inventories AS ivtr JOIN products AS proc ON ivtr.company_id = proc.company_id AND ivtr.product_id = proc.product_id JOIN warehouses AS wrhs ON ivtr.company_id = wrhs.company_id AND ivtr.warehouse_id = wrhs.warehouse_id WHERE ivtr.company_id = #{companyId}
AND proc.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCode}, '%')
AND proc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND wrhs.warehouse_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{warehouseCode}, '%')
AND wrhs.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{warehouseName}, '%')
AND ivtr.on_hand_qty = 0

SELECT wrhs.warehouse_id, wrhs.warehouse_code, wrhs.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(ivtr.on_hand_qty - ivtr.reseved_qty, 0) AS available_qty FROM inventories AS ivtr JOIN warehouses AS wrhs ON ivtr.company_id = wrhs.company_id AND ivtr.warehouse_id = wrhs.warehouse_id WHERE ivtr.company_id = #{companyId} AND ivtr.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT ivtr.inventory_id, ivtr.company_id, ivtr.product_id, ivtr.warehouse_id, ivtr.on_hand_qty, ivtr.reseved_qty, ivtr.version, ivtr.created_at, ivtr.updated_at, ivtr.deleted_at FROM inventories AS ivtr WHERE ivtr.company_id = #{companyId} AND ivtr.product_id = #{productId} AND ivtr.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId};
